credit_sentence: The stability conclusion follows from the actual-family miniversality and intrinsic pencil of \citet[Proposition~6.16 and Theorem~7.1]{DuEtAl2026v1}, together with the algebraic-reduction calculation of \citet[Theorem~9.1(i),(iii)]{AC2026}. The following complete proof retains the relative root-divisor calculation and the meromorphic descent argument.
